page.overview:
Who is Daahraan?

Daahraan, played by Hank Stone, is a minor character in the television series Mortal Kombat: Conquest episode "The Essence". Daahraan is a native citizen of Edenia and is said to be the keeper of the Essence of Edenia, a mystical power that holds the key to revitalize and restore his lost homeworld. He was an old friend of Princess Kitana and a teacher of the Great Kung Lao.

The Edenian warrior Daahraan and his people were once living in a time of prosperity and peace, until Shao Kahn the Konqueror led a surprise attack upon their world and had them all enslaved.

Daahraan went into hiding and yet, he was also keeping a very important secret, one that will regain Edenia's beauty and freedom.

Years later in Outworld, Princess Kitana found and made contact with Daahraan. He told her that the essence has been hidden away in Earthrealm where it is safe.
